name: Nam pia
summary: A Thái offal dish of cow or goat blood, with tail, stomach, and the base of the heart, cooked until the pot tightens. Eat it hot with banana flower and mint.
origin: Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La, the 21 March 2020 handbook. A second method was not re-read.
howToEat: Hot, from the pot, with banana flower and mint, and with rượu.
where: The Thái table in this province. The handbook does not pin a street. A price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nam pia in Son La — Thai offal from the handbook
seoDescription: Nậm pịa in Sơn La, set from cow or goat blood and the thick liquid of the small intestine. Eat it hot with banana flower and mint.
